similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the Navajo Lodge from the historical photo. It captures the complex asymmetric layout consisting of a large left wing, a recessed central lobby with a prominent stone chimney, and a smaller right wing. The double-pitched gabled roofs are correctly oriented with slopes extending outward and downward. Key architectural features, including the second-story wooden balcony, the rustic log-textured facade, stone-textured chimney, and multiple glass windows/doors, are modeled as distinct, tightly integrated components. The back and side walls are fully enclosed to ensure 360-degree structural integrity.
